description: This file defines an abstract class for comparison operators in an entity query framework, including methods for SQL generation, comparison logic, and evaluation of conditions.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: An abstract class for comparison operators used in entity query conditions, providing methods for SQL construction, value comparison, and condition evaluation.

methods.name: makeOroPattern
methods.description: Creates a Perl 5 regex pattern from a SQL LIKE pattern string.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL clauses involving entity conditions.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Appends SQL for the comparison operator to the provided StringBuilder, handling different value types.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if either operand in the comparison is considered empty.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereString
methods.description: Constructs the SQL fragment for the right-hand side of the comparison.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereStringValue
methods.description: Constructs the SQL fragment for the RHS value, handling nested condition values.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Abstract method to compare two values, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison within a given context, returning true or false.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Determines if the condition matches within the provided data map.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable or cached version of the value, if applicable.

methods.name: compareEqual
methods.description: Static method for comparing two comparable objects for equality.

methods.name: compareNotEqual
methods.description: Static method for comparing two objects for inequality.

methods.name: compareGreaterThan
methods.description: Static method to check if lhs is greater than rhs.

methods.name: compareGreaterThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if lhs is greater than or equal to rhs.

methods.name: compareLessThan
methods.description: Static method to check if lhs is less than rhs.

methods.name: compareLessThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if lhs is less than or equal to rhs.

methods.name: compareIn
methods.description: Static method to check if lhs is within rhs collection or equal to rhs.

methods.name: compareLike
methods.description: Static method to compare two strings with SQL LIKE pattern matching.
